entry.en: The passport must be valid at least 6 months after arrival in Angola and have at least 2 blank pages.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 6 meses después de la llegada a Angola y tener al menos 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Angola and have at least 2 blank pages.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is needed for some onward travel from Angola, including to South Africa.
entry.es: Se necesita certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla para algunos viajes posteriores desde Angola, como a Sudáfrica.
entry.quote: There is a risk of yellow fever transmission in Angola. This means you will need a certificate of yellow fever vaccination for some onward travel, including to South Africa.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 5,000 US dollars or more must be declared on arrival.
entry.es: Hay que declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viaje por valor de 5.000 dólares estadounidenses o más al llegar.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 5,000 US dollars or more (10,000 if you’re a resident). You’ll get a certified declaration to show you brought it in with you.

entry.en: You cannot take out more than 5,000 US dollars, or its equivalent in any foreign currency.
entry.es: No se puede sacar más de 5.000 dólares estadounidenses, o su equivalente en cualquier divisa.
entry.quote: You cannot take out more than 5,000 US dollars (10,000 if you’re a resident) or its equivalent in any foreign currency.

entry.en: Travel for work, study or business requires a visa obtained in advance.
entry.es: Viajar por trabajo, estudios o negocios requiere un visado obtenido con antelación.
entry.quote: If travelling for work, study or business, you must get a visa in advance.

entry.en: Overstaying a visa can bring a fine of 15,000 Angolan kwanzas a day.
entry.es: Quedarse más tiempo del permitido con el visado puede suponer una multa de 15.000 kwanzas angoleños al día.
entry.quote: You can be fined 15,000 Angolan kwanzas a day if you overstay your visa.

safety.en: There is a high level of crime in Luanda, some of it violent, and muggers can be armed.
safety.es: Hay un alto nivel de delincuencia en Luanda, parte violenta, y los asaltantes pueden ir armados.
safety.quote: There is a high level of crime in Luanda, some of it violent. Muggers can be armed and some attacks have been fatal. If you are attacked, hand over your money and valuables immediately.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to Cabinda Province, except Cabinda city.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje no esencial a la provincia de Cabinda, salvo a la ciudad de Cabinda.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to Cabinda Province, except to Cabinda city.

safety.en: Public gatherings and demonstrations can occur with little notice and can quickly turn violent.
safety.es: Las concentraciones y manifestaciones pueden producirse con poco aviso y volverse violentas rápidamente.
safety.quote: Public gatherings and demonstrations can occur with little notice and can quickly turn violent.

safety.en: Landmines and unexploded bombs and weapons are still a problem on roads, verges and bridges.
safety.es: Las minas terrestres y las bombas y armas sin explotar siguen siendo un problema en carreteras, arcenes y puentes.
safety.quote: Landmines and unexploded bombs and weapons are still a problem on roads, verges and bridges.

safety.en: Be particularly careful when withdrawing money from banks and ATMs, as you could be followed and robbed.
safety.es: Hay que tener especial cuidado al sacar dinero de bancos y cajeros, ya que pueden seguirle y robarle.
safety.quote: You should be particularly careful when withdrawing money from banks and ATMs, as you could be followed and robbed.

safety.en: Local minibus and coach transport is considered unsafe and should be avoided.
safety.es: El transporte local en minibús y autocar se considera inseguro y debe evitarse.
safety.quote: Local minibus and coach transport is considered unsafe and should be avoided.

health.en: Private clinics in Luanda charge high fees in advance, and healthcare outside Luanda is very limited.
health.es: Las clínicas privadas de Luanda cobran tarifas altas por adelantado, y la atención médica fuera de Luanda es muy limitada.
health.quote: There are several competent private clinics in Luanda. They charge high fees in advance. Outside Luanda healthcare is very limited.

health.en: Tap water should not be drunk in Angola, so stick to bottled water.
health.es: No se debe beber agua del grifo en Angola; hay que ceñirse al agua embotellada.
health.quote: Do not drink tap water. There is no working water purification system in Angola. Stick to bottled water.

health.en: Taking malaria prophylaxis when travelling to Angola is strongly recommended.
health.es: Se recomienda encarecidamente tomar profilaxis contra la malaria al viajar a Angola.
health.quote: It's strongly recommended to take malaria prophylaxis when travelling to Angola.

health.en: Yellow fever is prevalent, and vaccination is normally required before applying for an Angolan visa or travelling.
health.es: La fiebre amarilla es frecuente, y normalmente se exige vacunarse antes de solicitar el visado angoleño o viajar.
health.quote: Yellow fever is prevalent in the country. You are normally required to get vaccinated against the disease before applying for an Angolan visa and/or travelling to the country.

health.en: The Democratic Republic of Congo's Ministry of Health announced an Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the north-eastern Ituri Province.
health.es: El Ministerio de Salud de la República Democrática del Congo anunció un brote de ébola Bundibugyo en la provincia nororiental de Ituri.
health.quote: On 15 May the Democratic Republic of Congo Ministry of Health announced an outbreak of Ebola Bundibugyo in the North-Eastern Ituri Province.

health.en: Travel insurance should cover local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: El seguro de viaje debe cubrir el tratamiento local o una evacuación médica inesperada.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

help.en: Emergency numbers in Angola are 112 for ambulance, 118 for fire and 110 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Angola son el 112 para ambulancia, el 118 para bomberos y el 110 para policía.

getting_in.en: Luanda's Quatro de Fevereiro airport is 4 km outside the city and has public phones and bank facilities.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto Quatro de Fevereiro de Luanda está a 4 km de la ciudad y tiene teléfonos públicos y servicios bancarios.
getting_in.quote: Luanda-4-de-Fevereiro is situated 4 km outside Luanda. There are public phones and bank facilities at the airport.

getting_in.en: Afritaxi is described as the most reliable airport taxi system, but it only operates during daylight hours.
getting_in.es: Afritaxi se describe como el sistema de taxis más fiable desde el aeropuerto, pero solo opera de día.
getting_in.quote: The most reliable taxi system from the airport is Afritaxi. Their white vehicles are clearly marked, and they charge per km or per minute, depending on how bad traffic congestion is. They only operate during daylight hours.

getting_in.en: From Namibia you can enter at the border post near Oshikango/Ondjiva, which is open 24 hours.
getting_in.es: Desde Namibia se puede entrar por el puesto fronterizo de Oshikango/Ondjiva, abierto las 24 horas.
getting_in.quote: You can go in from Namibia at the border post near Oshikango(Namibia)/Ondjiva(Angola) which is open 24h/24.

getting_in.en: There are no railway links between Angola and other nations.
getting_in.es: No hay conexiones ferroviarias entre Angola y otros países.
getting_in.quote: There are no railway links between Angola and other nations.

getting_in.en: As of 2007, ferries were reported to run from the Cabinda enclave to Luanda.
getting_in.es: En 2007 se informaba de ferris que iban del enclave de Cabinda a Luanda.
getting_in.quote: There are (as of 2007) ferries running from the enclave of Cabinda to Luanda, which can be useful to avoid the unstable DR Congo.

getting_in.en: Visas obtained in countries to the north often give only a 5-day transit visa for Angola.
getting_in.es: Los visados obtenidos en países del norte suelen dar solo un visado de tránsito de 5 días para Angola.
getting_in.quote: When obtaining a visa from countries to the north, you will often only be issued a 5-day transit visa for Angola.

getting_around.en: The northern Luanda railway line (CFL) to Malanje is back to full service.
getting_around.es: La línea ferroviaria norte de Luanda (CFL) hacia Malanje ha vuelto al servicio completo.
getting_around.quote: The northern line Caminho de Ferro de Luanda (CFL) between the capital Luanda and Malenje is back to full service.

getting_around.en: Bus lines connect most of the major cities, from the coast to the interior.
getting_around.es: Hay líneas de autobús que conectan la mayoría de las grandes ciudades, de la costa al interior.
getting_around.quote: There are lines that connect most of the major cities of the country, from the coast to the interior.

getting_around.en: Local minibus transport is not safe.
getting_around.es: El transporte local en minibús no es seguro.
getting_around.quote: Local minibus transport is not safe.

getting_around.en: TAAG Angola Airlines offers scheduled domestic flights from Luanda to cities including Cabinda, Huambo, Lubango and Soyo.
getting_around.es: TAAG Angola Airlines ofrece vuelos nacionales regulares desde Luanda a ciudades como Cabinda, Huambo, Lubango y Soyo.
getting_around.quote: TAAG Angola Airlines offers scheduled flights around the country departing from Luanda to Cabinda, Catumbela, Dundo, Harare, Huambo, Kuito, Lubango, Luena, Menongue, Moçâmedes, Ondjiva, Saurimo, Soyo and Uíge

getting_around.en: A passenger ferry links Luanda with the oil port of Soyo and the enclave of Cabinda.
getting_around.es: Un ferry de pasajeros une Luanda con el puerto petrolero de Soyo y el enclave de Cabinda.
getting_around.quote: A passenger ferry links Luanda with the oil port of Soyo and the enclave of Cabinda.

getting_around.en: In the rainy season from November to April, bridges and even roads can be washed away.
getting_around.es: En la temporada de lluvias, de noviembre a abril, los puentes e incluso las carreteras pueden ser arrastrados por el agua.
getting_around.quote: However, during the rainy season (November to April), bridges and even roads can be washed away by water.

money.en: The currency of Angola is the Angolan kwanza (Kz, ISO code AOA).
money.es: La moneda de Angola es el kwanza angoleño (Kz, código ISO AOA).
money.quote: The currency of Angola is the Angolan kwanza, denoted by the symbol "Kz" (ISO code: AOA).

money.en: Most restaurants and small hotels only accept Angolan payment cards and cash, not foreign payment cards.
money.es: La mayoría de los restaurantes y hoteles pequeños solo aceptan tarjetas angoleñas y efectivo, no tarjetas extranjeras.
money.quote: Most restaurants and small hotels only accept Angolan payment cards and cash, but not foreign payment cards.

money.en: ATMs are common in cities, but in 2024 the maximum withdrawal was usually 60,000 Kz at BIC or 40,000 Kz at BAI.
money.es: Los cajeros son comunes en las ciudades, pero en 2024 el retiro máximo solía ser de 60.000 Kz en BIC o 40.000 Kz en BAI.
money.quote: ATMs are common in cities but the maximum withdrawal amount (in 2024) is usually 60,000 Kz (BIC bank, red logo) or 40,000 Kz (BAI bank, blue logo) which can be quickly spent if you pay everything with cash.

money.en: There is often a long queue at ATMs and they commonly run out of cash.
money.es: A menudo hay mucha cola en los cajeros y es común que se queden sin efectivo.
money.quote: There is often a long queue at the ATMs and they commonly run out of cash.

money.en: Not all restaurants accept US dollars in cash, so ask before ordering.
money.es: No todos los restaurantes aceptan dólares estadounidenses en efectivo, así que pregunte antes de pedir.
money.quote: Not all restaurants accept US dollars in cash; ask before ordering.

money.en: At the Benfica Handcrafts Market south of Luanda, bargaining is not only acceptable but recommended.
money.es: En el Mercado de Artesanía de Benfica, al sur de Luanda, regatear no solo es aceptable sino recomendable.
money.quote: This is an open market where local artists and artisans display their products, and bargaining is not only acceptable, but recommended.

etiquette.en: When visiting an Angolan home, it is customary to greet the oldest person first.
etiquette.es: Al visitar un hogar angoleño, es costumbre saludar primero a la persona de más edad.
etiquette.quote: When visiting an Angolan home, it is customary to greet the oldest person first.

etiquette.en: At a meal in an Angolan home, the oldest person in the house starts eating first.
etiquette.es: En una comida en un hogar angoleño, la persona de más edad de la casa empieza a comer primero.
etiquette.quote: If you've been invited for a meal at an Angolan person's home, bear in mind that the oldest person in the house starts eating first.

etiquette.en: Angolans consider it extremely rude to interrupt someone's conversation.
etiquette.es: Los angoleños consideran extremadamente grosero interrumpir la conversación de alguien.
etiquette.quote: Angolans are attentive listeners. They consider it extremely rude to interrupt someone's conversation.

etiquette.en: In rural areas, it is advised to take time to greet the local soba, the chief with government-backed authority.
etiquette.es: En zonas rurales se aconseja dedicar tiempo a saludar al soba local, el jefe con autoridad respaldada por el gobierno.
etiquette.quote: If travelling to rural areas, take some time to greet the local soba (chief with government-backed authority).

etiquette.en: Greet everyone respectfully and immediately upon seeing them; a simple Bom dia will do.
etiquette.es: Hay que saludar a todos con respeto e inmediatamente al verlos; basta un simple Bom dia.
etiquette.quote: Angolans are generally amiable, and it is important to greet everyone respectfully and immediately upon seeing them. A simple hello ("Bom dia") will do.

etiquette.en: Disrespecting government officials is a punishable offence, so be careful voicing political opinions in public or online.
etiquette.es: Faltar al respeto a funcionarios del gobierno es un delito sancionable, así que hay que tener cuidado al expresar opiniones políticas en público o en redes.
etiquette.quote: Be careful with voicing your political opinions in public or on social media; disrespecting government officials is a punishable offence in Angola.

connectivity.en: Telephone connections are heavily overloaded, making communication difficult at times, though international lines are often better.
connectivity.es: Las conexiones telefónicas están muy sobrecargadas y la comunicación a veces es difícil, aunque las líneas internacionales suelen ser mejores.
connectivity.quote: Telephone connections, cellular and landline, are heavily overloaded, making communication difficult at times. International lines are, however, often better.

connectivity.en: The phone country code of Angola is +244.
connectivity.es: El prefijo telefónico de Angola es +244.
connectivity.quote: The phone country code of Angola is +244.

connectivity.en: Carrying a satellite telephone is suggested in case of a breakdown or other emergency.
connectivity.es: Se sugiere llevar un teléfono satelital en caso de avería u otra emergencia.
connectivity.quote: Carry a satellite telephone in the case of a breakdown or other emergency.
